breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified that the provided vapor pressure head (Hv = 0.3 m) was inconsistent with water at 100°C. It corrected this by using the physically accurate value for water near boiling, setting Hv = 10.3 m, which aligns with the solution path suggested by the ground truth.
